newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Napocor to develop idle properties.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Napocor to develop idle properties.

text.p: Philippines' National Power Corp (Napocor) said on Friday it would develop four of its idle properties in Manila either through long-term leases or joint ventures.
Napocor president Guido Alfredo Delgado told reporters the company needed to develop the properties in order to supplement its revenues from power generation.

Delgado identified the properties as a 8,000 square metre land in Manila's Makati business district, a 1.6 hectare land in suburban Quezon city, a 4.0 hectare land in southern Paranaque district, and a 4,600 square metre land in downtown Manila.
Napocor is scheduling separate biddings this year to award the right to develop the lands to local real estate developers.
